H4400.def: from the same as «04397»; a message:--message.

H4401.def: from the same as «04397»; ministrative; Malaki, a prophet:--Malachi.

H4402.def: from «04390»; fulness, i.e. (concretely) a plump socket (of the eye):--X fitly.

H4403.def: or malbush {mal-boosh'}; from «03847»; a garment, or (collectively) clothing:--apparel, raiment, vestment.

H4405.def: from «04448» (plural masculine as if from milleh {mil-leh'}; a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic:--+ answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak(-ing), speak, talking, word.

H4406.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04405»; a word, command, discourse, or subject:--commandment, matter, thing. word.

H4407.def: or mil-loe (2 Kings 12:20) {mil-lo'}; from «04390»; a rampart (as filled in), i.e. the citadel:--Millo. See also «01037».

H4409.def: or Malluwkiy (Neh. 12:14) {mal-loo-kee'}; from «04427»; remnant; Malluk, the name of five Israelites:--Malluch, Melichu (from the margin).

H4410.def: feminine passive participle of «04427»; something ruled, i.e. a realm:--kingsom, king's, × royal.

H4411.def: from «03885»; a lodgment, i.e. caravanserai or encampment:--inn, place where...lodge, lodging (place).

H4412.def: feminine from «03885»; a hut, a hammock:--cottage, lodge.

H4413.def: apparently from «04448»; I have talked (i.e. loquacious):--Mallothi, an Israelite:--Mallothi.

H4414.def: a primitive root; properly, to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively, to disappear as dust; also (as denominative from «04417») to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt):--X at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away.

H4415.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04414»; to eat salt, i.e. (generally) subsist:--+ have maintenance.

H4417.def: from «04414»; properly, powder, i.e. (specifically) salt (as easily pulverized and dissolved:--salt((-pit)).

H4418.def: from «04414» in its original sense; a rag or old garment:--rotten rag.

H4419.def: from «04414» in its second. sense; a sailor (as following "the salt"):--mariner.

H4420.def: from «04414» (in its denominative sense); properly, salted (i.e. land (776 being understood)), i.e. a desert:--barren land(-ness), salt (land).

H4421.def: from «03898» (in the sense of fighting); a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare):--battle, fight(-ing), war((-rior)).

H4422.def: a primitive root; properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks:--deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, × speedily, × surely.

H4424.def: from «04423» and «03050»; (whom) Jah has delivered; Melatjah, a Gibeonite:--Melatiah.

H4425.def: from «04449» (in the sense of cropping (compare «04135»)); a head of grain (as cut off):--ear.

H4426.def: from «03887»; an aphorism; also a satire:--interpretation, taunting.

H4427.def: a primitive root; to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel:--consult, × indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, × surely.

H4429.def: the same as «04428»; king; Melek, the name of two Israelites:--Melech, Hammelech (by including the article).

H4431.et: from a root corresponding to (04427) in the sense of consultation
H4431.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «04427» in the sense of consultation: advice:--counsel.

H4432.def: from «04427»; Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites:--Molech. Compare «04445».

H4435.def: a form of «04436»; queen; Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite:--Milcah.

H4437.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04438»; dominion (abstractly or concretely):--kingdom, kingly, realm, reign.

H4438.def: or malkuth {mal-kooth'}; or (in plural) malkuyah {mal-koo-yah'}; from «04427»; a rule; concretely, a dominion:--empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.

H4439.def: from «04428» and «0410»; king of (i.e. appointed by) God; Malkiel, an Israelite:--Malchiel.

H4440.def: patronymical from «04439»; a Malkielite or descendant of Malkiel:--Malchielite.

H4441.def: or Malkiyahuw (Jer. 38:6), {mal-kee-yaw'-hoo}; from «04428» and «03050»; king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah; Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites:--Malchiah, Malchijah.

H4442.def: from «04428» and «06664»; king of right; Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine:--Melchizedek.

H4443.def: from «04428» and «07311»; king of a high one (i.e. of exaltation); Malkiram, an Israelite:--Malchiram.

H4444.def: from «04428» and «07769»; king of wealth; Malkishua, an Israelite:--Malchishua.

H4445.def: or Milkowm {mil-kome'}; from «04428» for «04432»; Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites:--Malcham, Milcom.

H4447.def: feminine active participle of «04427»; queen; Moleketh, an Israelitess:--Hammoleketh (including the article).

H4448.def: a primitive root; to speak (mostly poetical) or say:--say, speak, utter.

H4452.def: a primitive root; to be smooth, i.e. (figuratively) pleasant:--be sweet.

H4453.def: of Persian derivation; the butler or other officer in the Babylonian court:--Melzar.

H4454.def: a primitive root; to crack a joint; by implication, to wring the neck of a fowl (without separating it):--wring off.

H4455.def: from «03947»; transitively (in dual) the jaws (as taking food); intransitively, spoil (and captives) (as taken):--booty, jaws, prey.

H4456.def: from «03953»; the spring rain (compare «03954»); figuratively, eloquence:--latter rain.

H4457.def: or malqach {mal-kawkh'}; from «03947»; (only in dual) tweezers:--snuffers, tongs.

H4458.et: from an unused root meaning to spread out
H4458.def: from an unused root meaning to spread out; a wardrobe (i.e. room where clothing is spread):--vestry.

H4459.def: transp. for «04973»; a grinder, i.e. back tooth:--great tooth.

H4460.def: from «04048» (in the sense of depositing); a granary:--barn.

H4462.def: or (transp.) Mowmukan (Esth. 1:16) {mo-moo-kawn'}; of Persian derivation; Memucan or Momucan, a Persian satrap:--Memucan.

H4463.def: from «04191»; a mortal disease; concretely, a corpse:--death.

H4464.et: from an unused root meaning to alienate
H4464.def: from an unused root meaning to alienate; a mongrel, i.e. born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother:--bastard.

H4465.def: from «04376»; merchandise; abstractly, a selling:--X ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which...sold, ware.

H4466.def: feminine of «04465»; a sale:--+ sold as.

H4467.def: from «04427»; dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm):--kingdom, king's, reign, royal.

H4468.et: a form of (04467) and equiv. to it
H4468.def: a form of «04467» and equiv. to it:--kingdom, reign.

H4469.def: from «04537»; mixture, i.e. (specifically) wine mixed (with water or spices):--drink-offering, mixed wine.

H4470.et: from an unused root meaning to grieve
H4470.def: from an unused root meaning to grieve; sorrow:--bitterness.

H4471.def: from 4754(in the sense of vigor); lusty; Mamre, an Amorite:--Mamre.

H4473.et: from (04886), in the sense of expansion
H4473.def: from «04886», in the sense of expansion; outspread (i.e. with outstretched wings):--anointed.

H4474.def: from «04910»; a ruler or (abstractly) rule:--dominion, that ruled.

H4475.def: feminine of «04474»; rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler:--dominion, government, power, to rule.

H4476.def: from the same as «04943»; a possession:--breeding.

H4477.def: from «04985»; something sweet (literally or figuratively):--(most) sweet.

H4478.def: from «04100»; literally, a whatness (so to speak), i.e. manna (so called from the question about it):--manna.

H4479.def: (Aramaic) from «04101»; who or what (properly, interrogatively, hence, also indefinitely and relatively):--what, who(-msoever, + -so).

H4480.def: or minniy {min-nee'}; or minney (constructive plural) {min-nay'}; (Isaiah 30:11); for «04482»; properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses (as follows):--above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, × neither, × nor, (out) of, over, since, × then, through, × whether, with.

H4481.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04480»:--according, after, + because, + before, by, for, from, × him, × more than, (out) of, part, since, × these, to, upon, + when.

H4482.et: from an unused root meaning to apportion
H4482.def: from an unused root meaning to apportion; a part; hence, a musical chord (as parted into strings):--in (the same) (Psalm 68:23), stringed instrument (Psalm 150:4), whereby (Psalm 45:8 (defective plural)).

H4483.def: (Aramaic) or mnah (Aramaic) {men-aw'}; corresponding to «04487»; to count, appoint:--number, ordain, set.

H4486.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04093»; wisdom or intelligence:--knowledge, reason, understanding.

H4487.def: a primitive root; properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll:--appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.

H4488.def: from «04487»; properly, a fixed weight or measured amount, i.e. (techn.) a maneh or mina:--maneh, pound.

H4489.def: from «04487»; properly, something weighed out, i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance:--time.

H4490.def: from «04487»; properly, something weighed out, i.e. (generally) a division; specifically (of food) a ration; also a lot:--such things as belonged, part, portion.

H4492.def: from «05102»; properly, a channel or fissure, i.e. (by implication) a cavern:--den.

H4493.et: from (05110) a nodding or toss (of the head in derision)
H4493.def: from «05110» a nodding or toss (of the head in derision):--shaking.

H4494.def: from «05117»; quiet, i.e. (concretely) a settled spot, or (figuratively) a home:--(place of) rest.

H4495.def: the same as «04494»; rest; Manoach, an Israelite:--Manoah.

H4496.def: or mnuchah {men-oo-khaw'}; feminine of «04495»; repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode:--comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.

H4498.def: from «05127»; a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing:--X apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge.

H4499.def: or mnucah {men-oo-saw'}; feminine of «04498»; retreat:--fleeing, flight.
